redfin.remarks: TOP floor two bed, two bath condo with unobstructed views of San Pedro to the waterfront and Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach! An unexpected move is your opportunity! Enter to a bright, inviting and open floor plan encompassing the living, dining and kitchen plus deck - what could be better? The kitchen has quartz countertops , custom cabinetry with pull-outs to maximize storage, top-of-the-line Frigidaire Gallery stainless steel appliances and tile flooring. So much counterspace, there's room for a coffee bar and the air fryer! The primary suite is spacious, with south facing windows for morning natural light and a private ensuite bathroom with remodeled shower and modern fixtures. The second bedroom is also spacious, with large closet. Convenient in-unit washer and dryer closet with storage above, make laundry a snap. Engineered flooring throughout. Updated double pane windows and sliding glass door to deck. HOA includes Pool, Spa, Rec Room, Gym , Secured Entrance and elevator. Gated, subterranean parking garage, this unit comes with two side by side parking spots plus a storage cabinet. This is what you've been patiently waiting for - don't wait! Located in the sought after Palisades area of San Pedro, you’ll enjoy cool ocean breezes and effortless access to local favorites including Cabrillo Beach and Marina, Point Fermin Park, Angels Gate Park/Korean Friendship Bell, the downtown arts district, and the highly anticipated West Harbor waterfront development.
